Alguns pares de transformadas de Fourier
\(f(t)\) \(F(\omega)\)
\(\delta(t)\)\(1\)
\(\delta(t-a)\)\(e^{-i a\omega}\)
\(u(t)\)\(\pi\delta(\omega)+\dfrac{1}{i\omega}\)
\(1\)\(2\pi\delta(\omega)\)
\(\operatorname{sgn}(t)\)\(\dfrac{2}{i\omega}\)
\(e^{i\omega_0t}\)\(2\pi\delta(\omega-\omega_0)\)
\(\cos\omega_0t\)\(\pi\bigl(\delta(\omega-\omega_0)+\delta(\omega+\omega_0)\bigr)\)
\(\operatorname{sen}\omega_0t\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{i}\bigl(\delta(\omega-\omega_0)-\delta(\omega+\omega_0)\bigr)\)
\(\operatorname{rect}\left(\dfrac{t}{a}\right)\)\(\lvert a\rvert\cdot\operatorname{sinc}\left(a\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi}\right)=\dfrac{2}{\omega}\operatorname{sen}\left(\dfrac{\omega}{a}\right)\)
\(\cos(\omega_0t)u(t)\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\bigl(\delta(\omega-\omega_0)+\delta(\omega+\omega_0)\bigr)+\dfrac{i\omega}{\omega_0^2-\omega^2}\)
\(\operatorname{sen}(\omega_0t)u(t)\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{2i}\bigl(\delta(\omega-\omega_0)-\delta(\omega+\omega_0)\bigr)+\dfrac{\omega^2}{\omega_0^2-\omega^2}\)
\(\operatorname{rect}(t/a)\cos(\omega_0t)\)\(a\left(\operatorname{sinc}\dfrac{(\omega-\omega_0)a}{2\pi}+\operatorname{sinc}\dfrac{(\omega+\omega_0)a}{2\pi}\right)\)
\(\operatorname{sinc}\left(\dfrac{t}{a}\right)\)\(\lvert a\rvert\cdot\operatorname{rect}\left(\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi a}\right)\)
\(\operatorname{sinc}^2\left(\dfrac{t}{a}\right)\)\(\lvert a\rvert\cdot\operatorname{tri}\left(\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi a}\right)\)
\(e^{-at}u(t),\operatorname{Re}(a)>0\)\(\dfrac{1}{a+i\omega}\)
\(t^n\)\(2\pi i^n\delta^n(\omega)\)
\(t^{n-1}e^{-at}u(t),\operatorname{Re}(a)>0\)\(\dfrac{(n-1)!}{(a+i\omega)^n}\)
\(e^{-a\lvert t\rvert},\operatorname{Re}(a)>0\)\(\dfrac{2a}{a^2+\omega^2}\)
\(e^{-\pi t^2}\)\(e^{-\frac{\omega^2}{4\pi}}\)
\(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\lvert t\rvert}}\)\(\sqrt{\dfrac{2\pi}{\lvert\omega\rvert}}\)
\(\dfrac{1}{t^2+a^2}\)\(\dfrac{\pi}{a}e^{-a\lvert\omega\rvert}\)
\(\operatorname{tri}(t)\)\(\operatorname{sinc}^2\left(\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi}\right)\)

Transformadas operacionais

As transformadas de Fourier, assim como as de Laplace, podem ser classificadas como funcionais e operacionais.
